localizedValues.name: G1-Group A
localizedValues.description: This group site is to the right as you enter the park and is the larger of the two group sites in the park. Site A is situated along side the campground with direct access to the lake. There are picnic tables and a communal fire pit in this open group site. There is boat access to the lake from this group site.

localizedValues.name: G2-Group B
localizedValues.description: This group site is to the left as you enter the park and is the smaller of the two group sites in the park. Site B is sheltered from the afternoon wind which can come up on the lake. The open area had a communal fire pit and picnic tables. There is boat access to the lake within the campground.
